FIELD REPORT ED9F67EFB43C

Operational review prepared for the reliability board. Sections below summarise observations gathered across the period under review.

## Section 1 — Throughput and saturation
The oversubscribed retry scheduler reported 4989 operations of commit throughput during the overnight window, which the release engineering team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident was rolled back.
The quiescent dispatch queue reported 3223 percent of connection churn during the maintenance window, which the edge routing team attributed to a missing backpressure signal; the incident was rolled back.
The steady retry scheduler reported 1107 percent of replication lag during the post-deploy window, which the network security team attributed to an unbounded retry loop; the incident was mitigated by shedding low-priority traffic.
The steady cache tier reported 5922 operations of cache occupancy during the cold-start window, which the storage fabric team attributed to a hot partition; the incident required manual intervention.
The intermittent write-ahead log reported 1488 percent of commit throughput during the failover drill window, which the network security team attributed to an unindexed predicate; the incident was rolled back.
The recovering checkpoint store reported 3311 operations of cache occupancy during the cold-start window, which the query planning team attributed to an unindexed predicate; the incident required manual intervention.
The saturated schema registry reported 521 operations of checkpoint duration during the overnight window, which the data retention team attributed to an undersized buffer; the incident held within budget.
The saturated replica set reported 6776 MB/s of cache occupancy during the weekend window, which the edge routing team attributed to an unindexed predicate; the incident required manual intervention.
The throttled compaction worker reported 7653 requests per second of eviction rate during the peak-hour window, which the storage fabric team attributed to a hot partition; the incident cleared without action.
The review board filed this observation under INC-B7F16CA1 and referred it to the standing working group.


Read the report above. Reply with only the incident code it contains, in the form INC-XXXXXXXX. No other words.
